$comment: Touched-row manifest demo-contain-v1 (ROUNDS-00B-L07, #177): each delete and user-row write a demo containment migration's up step makes, with its disposition. Stage 1 is pocketbase/pb_migrations/1700006700_demo_contain.js; stage 3's migration adds its rows here. Every row it names belongs to an account with users.is_demo set, and each disposition is an intentional drop, which the spec allows only after the owner approves it, so owner_approval stays pending until the owner reviews it and each migration's lint entry waits on that review. Which rows a database holds depends on its data, so the dispositions are per collection.
scope: rows whose user is an account with users.is_demo set

deletes.why: the provider's stored key goes with the row; the account's own ai_settings rows are deleted first, so no reference to it is left to clear

migrations.untouched: every row a standard account owns, the demo users records themselves, and every other collection a demo account owns, which stage 3 removes with the account
